title: Heimdall progress and requirements
agenda: Sync up with the team about progress on the Heimdall efforts. Collect requirements for next steps.

title: Daily standup
agenda: Hold our daily standup with the team, round the room for updates and blockers, final last call at the end for missed rounds.

title: Heimdall milestone review
agenda: Heimdall milestone review. Purpose: decide whether the next milestone is ready and agree requirements for the next sprint. Attendees: engineering, product, operations and security. 1. Opening and intended decisions (5 min). 2. Progress against the milestone: demo completed work, compare scope to commitments, call out unfinished work (15 min). 3. Engineering and operational readiness: reliability risks, deployment plan, rollback, support ownership (15 min). 4. Requirements for next sprint: collect product needs and security constraints, separate must-have from follow-up, identify unanswered questions (15 min). 5. Close: decide go/no-go or list evidence still needed; recap actions, owners and due dates (10 min). Constraints: do not assume a release date or assign someone work without discussion. Park deep architecture debates for a follow-up. Capture any requirement that needs a separate ticket.
